summary.text: Tom Oxford, a Libertarian attorney from Nederland who has practiced since 1982 in personal injury, immigration and civil rights, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Attorney General of Texas to Nathan Johnson.
The Texas Tribune did not find public information about his policy stances, and he did not respond to Community Impact's questionnaire.

paragraphs.text: Oxford graduated from the University of Texas and the University of Houston College of Law, and he owns Oxford Law PLLC in Jefferson County.
He has argued cases before the Texas Supreme Court and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
He received 1.7% of the vote to Nathan Johnson's 52.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
